name: Theme
description: Sets color mode and theme inputs for the page or a nested subtree.
propsSummary: storageKey: string (default: fui-theme at the root; none when nested)

defaultMode.description: Default theme mode for uncontrolled usage

storageKey.description: localStorage key for persistence. A nested Theme persists only when given one

brand.description: Brand colour, any CSS colour; sets --fui-seed-brand

neutral.description: The neutral every plane, ink and line is a lightness step of: paper or any CSS colour; sets --fui-seed-neutral (chroma capped at 0.04)

radius.description: Base radius; a number is pixels; sets --fui-radius

pressScale.description: Scale an action takes while pressed, 1 turns it off; sets --fui-press-scale

primaryChrome.description: Primary action chrome: the accent ramp, or ink on the page plane; sets data-chrome

className.description: Class for the nested scope element; ignored at the root

style.description: Style for the nested scope element; ignored at the root

when: An app needs light and dark modes
The user's choice should survive a reload
You want to honour the OS setting by default
One region needs its own mode, brand or neutral (a dark panel, an ink toolbar, a rebranded preview)
whenNot: A single one-off color swap (use a CSS variable)
guidelines: The outermost Theme owns <html>: mode, storage and inputs are written there
A Theme inside another Theme scopes its subtree: it renders one <div data-fui-theme> and every role inside re-derives from what it sets
A nested Theme that sets no mode, input, className or style renders nothing and passes the parent context through
Put ThemeScript in <head> with the same storageKey and inputs as the root Theme so a reload paints the stored mode first; add suppressHydrationWarning to <html>
useTheme reads and sets the nearest Theme's mode
storageKey renames the localStorage entry; storage that throws falls back to the default mode
Popups opened inside a scope carry it into their portal
Theme renders no chrome of its own; the colour-mode control is a composition: a ToggleGroup wired to useTheme (System, Light, Dark, System first), or one IconButton calling setMode in a tight toolbar
Without a Theme, useTheme reads and writes data-theme on <html> directly; toggleMode steps system → light → dark
accessibility: Name the colour-mode control (aria-label "Colour mode"); a flip button's label names the mode it switches to
A scoped theme re-derives every ink and plane, so text holds 4.5:1 inside it
